svg.text: State-Space Model — one linear recurrence, two equal forms

g.text: Parameters A,B,C,D given; nothing computed yet.
t=1: input x₁=1 enters, scaled ×B into the combine.
t=3: x₃=2 mixes with the twice-decayed tail.
Convolution: yₜ = Σⱼ k₍ₜ₋ⱼ₎·xⱼ — the same linear model.
k₀=6, k₁=3, k₂=1.5 reproduce y=[6, 3, 13.5] identically.

svg.text: dashed outline = general d-dim shape (d=1 shown for arithmetic) · gold ring = the element changing this step

g.text: Convolution form (same answer, computed a different way): yₜ = Σⱼ k₍ₜ₋ⱼ₎·xⱼ
fixed kernel kₖ = C·Aᵏ·B : k₀ = C·B = 3·2 = 6 · k₁ = C·A·B = 3·0.5·2 = 3 · k₂ = C·A²·B = 3·0.25·2 = 1.5

svg.text: • Invariant: state h has a fixed size ∀t — same size at step 3 or step 3,000.
• Cost: O(n) total, O(1) state/step — vs attention's O(n²) (not drawn).
• recurrence ⇄ convolution: an exact identity from linearity, not a trade-off.
• A,B,C,D are learned parameters (e.g. neural-network weights; not drawn).
